The WLMOUSE Ying75 keyboard uses custom Gateron Nightfall and TTC Shadow magnetic switches. These switches use magnets and sensors instead of physical contacts to process actuations, creating a much smoother keypress without bounce or chatter. The adjustable actuation point is determined not by location but by distance travelled.
Magnetic Switch Functionality:
End: Trigger a different action upon releasing the key.
DKS: Assign up to four actions at different levels of key actuation.
TGL: Tap a key to toggle repeat functionality, and hold it for the standard action.
MPT: Set three different actions for one key, each triggered at various actuation levels.
MT: Configure two distinct functions for any key—one for tapping and another for holding.
SOCD: Fast input transitions by instantly triggering directional changes when switching between opposing keys (e.g. A / D), without needing to fully release the first key.
Macros: Bind complex macros to any key, allowing you to execute a series of commands or actions with a single press.

This means immediate key reactions—press to activate, release to reset—allowing for faster, more precise keystrokes. In rapid gameplay, this translates to executing complex actions in real-time without delay, giving you a serious advantage during fast-paced sequences.
Dynamic Keystrokes: Thanks to Dynamic Keystrokes (DKS), you can now assign up to 4 distinct actions per key based on press depth. A light press moves your character, a deeper press makes them run, and releasing the key enables additional commands. This layered control lets you execute multiple moves with ease, streamlining gameplay while enhancing control and speed, making your reactions quicker and more precise.
Analog Mode: Analog Mode Experience the power of Analog Mode, bringing game controller-like precision to your keyboard. This mode enables variable inputs instead of the usual on/off signals, letting you achieve more fluid and dynamic control. With each keypress, the keyboard detects how far you press, translating it into different speeds and intensities. Enjoy nuanced control and heightened responsiveness in racing games, sports simulations, and more.
